acceptance.given: A public entry may depend on caller setup that its declaration does not identify.

oracle.expected: Declaration inspection identifies all caller setup required by the entry; invocation without required setup fails its preflight before dependent processing.
forbidden: The entry succeeds only because undeclared caller setup was performed.
Required caller setup is hidden from the declaration.
oracle.observable: At contract review, inspect the declaration alongside the entry's preflight/invocation boundary and verify required setup is declared or rejected before processing.

acceptance.then: The declaration and invocation boundary expose every required caller setup, or preflight blocks an invocation missing required setup.
acceptance.when: Review the public entry declaration and its preflight behavior with required caller setup absent.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the public-entry declaration and preflight check for omitted required caller setup; fail if setup is undisclosed or processing proceeds without it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Verify the public-entry declaration and preflight boundary disclose all required caller setup and block missing required setup before dependent processing.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema changes; rollback removes the targeted contract/preflight assertion.

slice_hint.state_transition: An entry invocation with missing required setup is either shown to be self-contained under its declaration or blocked at preflight before processing.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The declaration and preflight check detects undisclosed required setup and verifies it is not silently relied upon.

acceptance.given: A public entry has legitimate child dependencies.

oracle.expected: The declaration names every legitimate child dependency of that public entry.
forbidden: A legitimate child dependency is omitted.
The declaration represents child dependency requirements as absent when they exist.
oracle.observable: At declaration validation, inspect the parsed public-entry declaration and compare its child dependencies with the legitimate dependencies identified for that entry.

acceptance.then: The declaration explicitly identifies every legitimate child dependency.
acceptance.when: Validate the public-entry declaration against its legitimate child-dependency set.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the public-entry declaration check for a known legitimate child dependency set; fail when any legitimate child is omitted or dependencies are represented as absent.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Verify that each public-entry declaration explicitly names all legitimate child dependencies.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema changes; rollback removes the targeted declaration assertion.

slice_hint.state_transition: A declaration is checked against its legitimate child dependencies and an incomplete declaration is identified.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Declaration validation detects an omitted legitimate child dependency.

acceptance.given: Dependency evaluation encounters one of these conditions: a required dependency is missing, a dependency version is incompatible, or dependency authority cannot be resolved.

oracle.expected: Each condition produces a typed blocking diagnostic that prevents dependent processing.
forbidden: A missing required dependency lacks a typed blocking diagnostic.
An incompatible version lacks a typed blocking diagnostic.
An unresolved authority lacks a typed blocking diagnostic.
Any of the conditions is silently accepted or produces an untyped or non-blocking result.
oracle.observable: For each condition, inspect the dependency evaluation result for diagnostic type and blocking status, and inspect whether dependent processing was prevented.

acceptance.then: The applicable condition transitions dependency evaluation to blocked with its typed diagnostic, and dependent processing does not proceed.
acceptance.when: Evaluate each of the three dependency failure conditions and observe its diagnostic and dependent-processing boundary.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select dependency-evaluation behavior checks for missing-required, incompatible-version, and unresolved-authority cases; each must observe a typed blocking diagnostic and halted dependent processing.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Dependency evaluation emits typed blocking diagnostics for missing required dependencies, incompatible versions, and unresolved authority, preventing dependent processing.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema changes; rollback restores the prior dependency evaluation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Encountered dependency failure transitions evaluation to blocked with a typed diagnostic before dependent processing.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: All three dependency failure cases yield typed blocking diagnostics and dependent processing is prevented.

acceptance.given: An optional dependency is absent and that dependency has a declared fallback available for evaluation.

oracle.expected: Dependency evaluation follows the declared fallback for the absent optional dependency.
forbidden: Optional absence is treated as undeclared behavior.
Optional absence bypasses or contradicts the declared fallback.
oracle.observable: Inspect the dependency evaluation result and selected fallback path for the absent optional dependency.

acceptance.then: Processing transitions to the declared fallback for the optional dependency.
acceptance.when: Evaluate the optional-dependency absence case and observe the selected fallback path.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the optional-dependency absence behavior check; fail if evaluation does not follow that dependency's declared fallback.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Dependency evaluation follows the declared fallback when an optional dependency is absent.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema changes; rollback restores the prior optional-dependency handling behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Optional dependency absence transitions to execution of its declared fallback.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The optional absence case follows its declared fallback and does not bypass it or treat absence as undeclared behavior.
